item.title: Website refonte with Hugo (part 2)
item.description: Week 1 proved the repo could carry more than a PDF résumé. This is the refonte log: same Hugo root, different product — Paper instead of HBTheme, EN/FR pairs, typed posts, a projects catalog, and MCP when a diagram or draft needs to land in git faster. Sequel to Create a portfolio with Hugo (week 1). Version française.
